assessments.reasoning: Authenticity follows from spdx_detail at SPDX's commit-pinned license-list-data path json/details/CC0-1.0.json. Integrity follows from matching reported digests for all four cited ranges. Relevance follows from [16343,16366) giving licenseId CC0-1.0, [16293,16340) giving the asserted name, [4,35) setting isDeprecatedLicenseId to false, and [16636,16718) giving the legalcode URL in seeAlso. Interpretation follows from the fields being catalog metadata. Applicability follows from the URL pin matching spdx_data_tag.object.sha. The contradiction check finds the same ID, name and URL in spdx_xml [99,337), and the edition path in publisher_readme [4999,5294).

Authenticity follows from the publisher's pinned publisher_readme. Integrity follows from its matching [4999,5294) digest. Relevance follows from the example's canonical https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ URL. Interpretation follows from the title “CC0 1.0 Universal” attached to that URL. Applicability follows from spdx_detail.seeAlso naming legalcode under that exact edition path and publisher_live serving legalcode.txt there. The contradiction check finds agreement with publisher_pin [0,48) despite the longer SPDX catalog name. The README establishes the publisher side of the correspondence only.

Authenticity follows from spdx_xml at SPDX's pinned src/CC0-1.0.xml path. Integrity follows from the matching [99,337) digest. Relevance follows from the license element's ID CC0-1.0, name Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal and crossRef ending /publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode. Interpretation follows from their roles as source metadata for the catalog entry. Applicability follows from spdx_xml_tag.object.sha and the job's checked-out SHA both equaling the XML URL pin. The contradiction check directly matches the two attributes to spdx_detail.licenseId and name, and the full crossRef URL to both crossRef[0].url and seeAlso[0] at the separate data pin. The XML provides source-lineage context.

Authenticity follows from spdx_data_tag at the SPDX data repository's Git tag-object API. Integrity follows from the matching whole-response [0,700) digest and object address 76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b. Relevance follows from tag v3.29.0 and its version 3.29.0 SPDX License List annotation. Interpretation follows from object.type being commit and object.sha being 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48, distinct from the tag object's own SHA. Applicability follows from that target equaling the spdx_detail URL pin. The contradiction check finds the same full SHA in spdx_generation and its prefix in the job push. The API reports an unsigned annotation.

Authenticity follows from spdx_xml_tag at the SPDX XML repository's Git tag-object API. Integrity follows from the matching whole-response [0,698) digest and object address 7523cc3daa7149e35e2debd7466c1dcb14a84e19. Relevance follows from tag v3.29.0 and its version 3.29.0 SPDX License List annotation. Interpretation follows from its direct commit target b1dbeb5c8bca21af860a90e187f71d60b84a7a40. Applicability follows from that target equaling the spdx_xml URL pin. The contradiction check finds the full target printed after checkout in spdx_release_job [12464,12534). The unsigned tag provides XML release context.

Authenticity follows from spdx_generation at the SPDX data repository's Git commit API. Integrity follows from the matching whole-response [0,1237) digest and returned SHA 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48. Relevance follows from its message, “License list build 3.29.0 using license list publisher 3.1.4”. Interpretation follows from the object recording a generated-data build with sole parent 3027e0ce357ad6290902c4b57a677fc3b55051b9. Applicability follows from the returned SHA equaling both the inspected JSON pin and the data tag target. The contradiction check finds the same message at job [78070,78175), matching old and new prefixes at [78398,78461), and the same release number in both tags.

Authenticity follows from spdx_release_job at the authenticated GitHub Actions log endpoint for SPDX XML job 104892289184. Integrity follows from the reported original body SHA-256 1e9137b29385a9ce0deaa48c20ab9927916426819a69f0cfc6281d239340c282 and the six matching range digests. Relevance follows from the fetch mapping the full XML SHA to refs/tags/v3.29.0 [10328,10526), the actual checkout [11093,11190), and the Git HEAD query [12394,12464) returning b1dbeb5c8bca21af860a90e187f71d60b84a7a40 [12464,12534). Interpretation follows from the subsequent cleanup of old data directories, generator invocation on src, generated commit 31ba1a5 with the 3.29.0/3.1.4 message [78070,78175), and successful data-main update 3027e0c..31ba1a5 [78398,78461). Applicability follows from spdx_xml and spdx_detail being retrieved at the respective input and output commits. The contradiction check resolves the checkout against the XML tag, the output against the data tag, and both push prefixes against spdx_generation.sha and parents[0].sha. These observations establish deployment context within the SPDX lineage.

limitations: The crosswalk establishes what this SPDX release documents. Text equivalence, copyright classification and any particular project's grant require separate evidence.

The XML, generated details, tags, commit and build log share the corresponding SPDX information lineage. The tags and commit are unsigned. Their repository attribution does not establish signer identity.

The fixed tool reported the entire 81,691-byte original job body. The displayed output elided an intervening portion, but all six cited passages and the generator invocation were visible. The byte-range citations are derived from that body.
The job and pinned files support causal attribution for the bounded generated record. A complete bit-for-bit build reproduction was not performed.
reasoning: At data commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48, SPDX lists CC0-1.0 as “Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal” and points to https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode. The source XML at b1dbeb5c8bca21af860a90e187f71d60b84a7a40 supplies the same ID, name and URL. The publisher's edition documentation identifies the referenced instrument. The annotated tags identify the two release revisions, and the job connects the checked-out XML source to the generated data commit containing the inspected JSON.
